personal.text: Glad that helped! I built BojuBot so your notes and your AI could actually work together. Thanks for using it.
You're welcome, from me too! I'm Scott, and I make BojuBot. It's great to see it pulling its weight.
Thanks for the thanks! Every one of these reminds me why I keep building BojuBot.
Happy to help. I hope BojuBot keeps making your vault feel a little more alive.
That made my day. Thanks for trusting BojuBot with your notes.
Glad it worked out! If something ever doesn't, I'd love to hear about it.
You're welcome! BojuBot is a one-person project, and moments like this are the best part of it.
Nice work, the two of you. Thanks for using BojuBot.

sponsor.text: Glad it helped! If BojuBot saves you time, a coffee helps me keep it going.
Thanks! BojuBot is free and made by one person. If it's earned a place in your workflow, consider supporting it.
Happy to help! Using BojuBot at work? Asking your company to sponsor it keeps updates coming.
You're welcome! Every coffee goes toward server costs and dev tools, and more free software.

help.text: Glad it helped! If you like BojuBot, a star on GitHub helps other people find it.
Thanks! Know someone with an Obsidian vault? Telling them about BojuBot is the best help there is.
Happy to help! Got an idea that would make BojuBot better? I read everything.
You're welcome! Questions, ideas, or just want to share what you built? Come say hi on Discord.
